newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Southern Philippine businesses call off strike.
newsitem.headline: Southern Philippine businesses call off strike.

text.p: Business leaders in the southern Philippines called off a threatened one-week strike against kidnapping after meeting police, a business official said on Tuesday.

"The strike is postponed indefinitely," an official at the Cotabato Filipino-Chinese Chamber of Commerce and Industry Inc said after a meeting with Interior Secretary Robert Barbers and Philippine National Police chief Recaredo Sarmiento.

Business officials from three local chambers representing about 300 businesses had threatened to close down for a week from Wednesday to protest against a rise in kidnapping incidents in Cotabato, 880 km (547 miles) south of Manila.
He said the police had promised to arrest kidnappers in the city where police have recorded 15 kidnappings since the start of the year. One Chinese-Filipino trader was murdered.
